import urllib.request
url='https://www.hms.harvard.edu/bss/neuro/bornlab/nb204/papers/prinz-marder-2004.pdf'
req=urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 neuron-channels (mailto:a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk)'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as r:
    print('status', r.status, 'ctype', r.headers.get('Content-Type'), 'len', r.headers.get('Content-Length'))
    data = r.read()
print('downloaded', len(data), 'bytes; head:', data[:8])
out = 'tasks/t0097_multi_obj_optim/assets/paper/10.1038_nn1352/files/prinz_2004_disparate-circuit-parameters.pdf'
open(out,'wb').write(data)
print('saved to', out)
